role: targeted primary-source capability check, not systematic novelty review

sources.title: Google SRE: Service Level Objectives
sources.inspection: Primary chapter, SLI/SLO definitions and aggregation discussion
sources.capability: Defines outcome, objective and aggregation; multiple objectives and distribution-aware evaluation are established.

sources.title: Reeve: A short proof of the Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz-Massart inequality
sources.inspection: Primary theorem and corollaries; independence/common-CDF premises
sources.capability: Uniform empirical-to-population CDF sampling bounds; does not supply future drift control.

sources.title: NIST: Confidence intervals for a proportion
sources.inspection: Exact binomial interval equations and worked 4/20, 90% example
sources.capability: Ordinary binomial target uncertainty; independent Bernoulli assumptions remain necessary.

sources.title: CEDULE, ICAC 2018
sources.inspection: Primary paper; earlier local capability audit retained; current PDF opening
sources.capability: Profile-based tail prediction and resource-decision contracts are established; not executed in this audit.

sources.title: Barber et al.: Conformal prediction beyond exchangeability
sources.inspection: Primary author abstract; earlier local full-text capability audit retained
sources.capability: Drift-aware predictive inference is established; our sampling bands do not reproduce it.

sources.title: Saxena et al.: Towards Performance Robustness for Microservices, NSDI 2026
sources.inspection: Primary abstract, introduction and Section 2; model/scope opening, not full artifact audit
sources.capability: Galileo/PERC certificates address tail-latency robustness under bounded environmental perturbations and guide learned SLO controllers. Its richer model/control contract is not reproduced or refuted here.
